title: Red Hat Security Advisory: perl-XML-LibXML security update
description: A security vulnerability in the perl-XML-LibXML module allows denial of service via truncated UTF-8 sequences in XML node names. This module provides a Perl interface to the GNOME libxml2 library for XML parsing and manipulation. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-8177 and affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.6 versions with this module. Red Hat has issued a security update to address this issue.
